    1. PFLink(InfraredEmitter)

Class PFLink

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.pf.PFLink
public final class PFLink extends Object
The Power Functions infrared link: the message framing and the transmission of a Power Functions command over an InfraredEmitter, as RcxLink is for the RCX. Create one at startup with the emitter and share it with every RemotePF that talks to the same receivers, so they share one toggle bit.

A message is 16 bits of four 4-bit fields (toggle, escape and channel; output and mode; data; checksum) sent as a 38 kHz burst of 6 cycles per bit, followed by a pause of 10 cycles for a 0, 21 for a 1 and 39 for the start and stop marks. It is sent six times, so the receiver does not miss it, which takes about 80 ms.
